::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Jan 2nd [1866]  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54920: 130-1
:::

Dear [Mr Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd)
I think I was to have 6 copies of the [Prince and Page](cmy_books/cmybook_61.qmd) sent to myself - also in the same parcel one of the [Heir of Redclyffe](cmy_books/cmybook_15.qmd). I have seen nothing of them so perhaps they have been forgotten or come to some mischance by the way.

With all new years greetings
Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

**Note:** Endorsed ‘Rail January 3rd’.
